name: core_test_access_devices
description: Ops core plan section 10 part 1: test_access_devices through the network routes, captured before any ops-core edit.

scenario.scenario_brief:
TEST: Access model devices

A test floor for the physical pentest devices (PHYSICAL_PENTEST_DEVICES_PLAN.md). The rogue AP half is in reception: hide the pocket rogue AP in a reception plant, clone a network from its console and wait for Kieran's laptop. The drop box half sits behind the patch panel.
scenario.endGoal: Test only: run the device beats.

lw_fs01_records.name: Client-Records
lw_fs01_records.observations: Top folders, one per client. Any device on the network can list the names; what is inside them is client records, so open none of it.

lw_callmgr.name: Call manager
lw_callmgr.observations: The call manager for the office phones. It answers on the voice network with the extension list: 100 reception, 101 open plan. Calls are set up here and nothing else.

lw_ph_recep.name: Reception desk phone
lw_ph_recep.observations: A desk phone registered as extension 100. Its call signalling is all that answers.

lw_ph_open1.name: Open plan desk phone
lw_ph_open1.observations: A desk phone registered as extension 101. Its call signalling is all that answers.

contents.name: Facilities requests
contents.text:
Facilities requests (test)

Door faults, the post-room printer and the contractor visits booked this week. The booking list tells a stranger which names and uniforms reception expects. Booking a visit is out of scope.

startItemsInInventory.name: Pocket rogue AP
startItemsInInventory.observations: A pocket box that broadcasts a copy of a Wi-Fi network's name. The copy is open, because it cannot know the real key, so nobody's laptop joins it on its own: a person has to pick it. Hide it in a plant in reception, then set it up from its console.

hideable.confirm: Hide the pocket rogue AP in this plant?

startItemsInInventory.name: Harvested Credentials
startItemsInInventory.observations: Your capture tablet: the keys and passwords the test has recorded, each shown in full.

startItemsInInventory.name: Your phone
startItemsInInventory.observations: Your work phone, with Ruth a message away.

startItemsInInventory.name: Network drop box
startItemsInInventory.observations: A palm-sized network drop box from the kit, with an Ethernet socket and its own radio. Plug it into a live wall port to join that port's network.

objectives.title: Wireless
objectives.description: Plant the pocket rogue AP in reception and see what a copy of the staff Wi-Fi harvests: the shared Wi-Fi key, or one person's staff sign-in. Either harvest completes this aim.

tasks.title: Harvest something with the rogue AP: the Wi-Fi key page or the staff sign-in page
Optional: harvest the staff Wi-Fi key with the rogue AP's key page
Optional: join the staff Wi-Fi with the harvested key
Optional: harvest a staff sign-in with the rogue AP's sign-in page
Optional: sign in at the hot desk with the account the portal harvested

objects.name: Plant by the back wall
objects.observations: A tall plant against the back wall.

objects.name: Planted rogue AP
objects.observations: Your pocket rogue AP, tucked into the plant. Click the plant to open its console.

cloneLog.wifi_key: Copy of Ledgerwell-Staff up (open), showing the Wi-Fi key page. Simulated disconnect (a real test would not send these). Waiting for someone to pick the copy.
cloneLog.staff_signin: Copy of Ledgerwell-Staff up (open), showing the staff sign-in page. Simulated disconnect (a real test would not send these). Waiting for someone to pick the copy.

apScan.cloneLog: Copy of Ledgerwell-Guest up (open). It harvests nothing worth having: the guest key is printed on a card in reception, and staff laptops hold the staff network, not this one.

apScan.refusal: Out of scope. BT-Hub-4F2A is not the client.
Out of scope. Corrigan Dental is not the client.

wordings.text: Ledgerwell-Staff: the router has been updated. Enter the Wi-Fi key to reconnect.
Ledgerwell-Staff: the network now uses staff accounts. Sign in with your Ledgerwell username and password.

apCaptureLog.text: Kieran's laptop joined the copy; Wi-Fi key page submitted.
Kieran's laptop joined the copy; staff sign-in page submitted.

objects.name: Ledgerwell-Staff access point
objects.observations: A wall access point above the waiting area. Its label reads Ledgerwell-Staff. It asks for a key.

objects.name: Ledgerwell-Guest access point
objects.observations: A second access point on the wall. Its label reads Ledgerwell-Guest.

objects.name: Reception Wi-Fi card
objects.text:
Visitors: connect your laptop to the wireless.
Network name (SSID): Ledgerwell-Guest
Key: Visitor-Pebble-2026
objects.observations: A printed flyer pinned to the wall with the guest Wi-Fi details.

objects.name: Hot desk PC
objects.observations: A spare desk with a PC on the office domain. Only Kieran's account signs in here in this test.

objects.name: Kieran's laptop
objects.observations: Kieran's laptop on the front desk.

addCapture.note: Kieran's laptop picked the copy and the Wi-Fi key page took the key (proof: planted).

eventMappings.bark: That is the staff Wi-Fi key. Read it on your tablet, then try it on the staff access point.
That is Kieran's sign-in. Read it on your tablet and try it at the hot desk.

eventMappings.condition: value === true && globalVars.ap_planted === true && globalVars.ap_twin_staff === true && !globalVars.kp_twin_captured && !globalVars.kp_twin_account_captured
eventMappings.bark: Nothing has picked your copy yet. Kieran's laptop is the likely one; give him a minute. If you reloaded, the capture lands once Kieran is working again.

eventMappings.condition: value === true && globalVars.ap_portal_account === true && globalVars.ap_twin_staff === true && !globalVars.kp_twin_account_captured
eventMappings.bark: Your copy now asks for a staff sign-in. Kieran's laptop has to pick it again; give him a minute. If you reloaded, the capture lands once Kieran is working again.

addCapture.note: Joined the staff Wi-Fi with the harvested key: one shared key, and the staff Wi-Fi is the office LAN.
A password typed into a fake Wi-Fi page opened a staff desk. The control is a second factor on every sign-in.

voice.name: Achird
voice.style: Office junior on the front desk of a small British firm, early twenties, Irish, from Dublin. Speak with a consistent Dublin accent throughout. Do not shift to any other accent. Light, quick, cheerful; always slightly in a hurry, never rude.

eventMappings.bark: My Wi-Fi dropped, so I picked the network again. It wanted the key again, so I typed it in.
The Wi-Fi dropped again, and this time it wanted my Ledgerwell sign-in, so I typed that in.

addCapture.note: Typed his staff sign-in into the rogue AP's sign-in page (proof: planted).
